title: Playschool Franchise Opportunity
name: Mini Club Scooby, 300 Franchisees, Est'd in 2003, Novara HQ
description: Master franchise opportunity for the Mini Club Scooby preschool network, based on the certified Italian Montessori Method. - Seeking franchise partners to establish and operate preschools offering nursery, kindergarten, drop-in childcare, and corporate daycare services under the Mini Club Scooby brand. - Franchisees receive a turnkey business format, standardized Montessori educational system, certified training, operational support, and access to specialized educational materials designed to foster children's independence, creativity, and cognitive and emotional development. - The brand is differentiated by its certified Italian Montessori Method, strong emphasis on educational quality, and international experience, including the successful export of the "Scoobyland" educational project to China. - Operates under a trademark registered in Italy, with a renewable 12-year master franchise agreement supporting long-term expansion. - The business aims to build an international network of Montessori preschools through a scalable franchise model. - Registered and affiliated with the Ministry of Education, supporting compliant educational operations.
